svg.title: THE WORLD IS OURS — Zolboo
svg.desc: Zolboo, full-stack developer from Mongolia. TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase. A night scene: a sakura tree in blossom stands against a starlit navy sky with a gleaming full moon behind its branches, shedding pink petals that drift down over rolling waves. 世界は我らのもの — THE WORLD IS OURS.
